events.description: The ban on Runescape discussions has been lifted; a Runescape sub-forum was reopened with new rules.
A forum rules compilation page was created listing all forum-specific rules.
Creating threads involving buying/selling/trading outside the Marketplace will now result in a ban; a new 'Not In Marketplace' report option was added.
A Post Activity link was added to each member's profile, letting l33ts and ub3rs see how many posts a member has in individual sections.
A Hackintosh Help sub-forum was added under Apple Mac and OS X for setup help and build guides.
A Partnerships, Hiring, and Personnel sub-forum was added under Service Offerings.
A new Virtual Game Items section was added under the Marketplace for selling Runescape gold, WoW equipment, and similar items; account trading is not allowed there.

Rusty_v's account was compromised; the attacker repfucked 3 members, removed many reps, and swapped Liberty Reserve payment links to their own LR ID. He was also demoted from Staff to Mentor with no public reason given.
Omniscient published a list of currently country-blocked countries; the list is not permanent and is subject to change.
Scooter crossed 1,000 reputation, joining the top members; тнєJσкєя is climbing toward second place behind Omniscient.
Vitani's Mate reached 20,000 posts in nine months at over 85 posts per day, less than 2,000 from first place in highest post count.
SeaNanners™'s 'first time eating sushi' video, posted to win the Sushi Lovers award, was revealed by Defcon. to be a lie with leeched footage.
Anime Adventures launched AARadio, a member-run radio station headed by Tasemu.
Members posted threads warning about Avante's hosting; Poliice published a warning thread alongside Avante's main hosting thread.
Interview with DiscipLe conducted by Valik ϟ; covers his gaming setup, favorite consoles, and competitive gaming experience.
